shortInfo: Southern Railway has announced notification for Act Apprentices posts. Required qualification: 10th, 12th, ITI. Last date to apply: 27-09-26.
howToApply: Visit the official website: www.sr.indianrailways.gov.in
Navigate to News & Updates → Personnel Branch Information
Click on the relevant notification link for Act Apprentices Notification No. 01/2026
Fill in the online application form with all required personal, educational and technical details
Upload required documents as specified
Pay the processing fee of Rs. 100/- through online mode (SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates are exempted)
Submit the application before 27-09-2026 till 17:00 Hrs
Take a printout of the acknowledgement generated by the system for submission at the time of Document Verification

title: Visakhapatnam Port Authority Recruitment 2026 – Trade Apprentices (Welder, Electrician, Fitter, Motor Mechanic, Electronics) Posts
shortInfo: Visakhapatnam Port Authority has announced notification for Trade Apprentices (Welder, Electrician, Fitter, Motor Mechanic, Electronics) posts. Required qualification: Passed ITI in the respective trade. Last date to apply: 23-09-26.
howToApply: Candidates should register in the NAPS Apprentice portal at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
After registration, go to ‘Find an Apprentice Opportunity’ and click ‘Search Opportunity’.
Select the desired opportunity (trade) and set course type as ‘Designated’.
Select location as ‘Andhra Pradesh’ and search Establishment as ‘Visakhapatnam Port Authority’.
Click ‘Apply’ to submit the application.
